claim_text: The 20% pass-through business income deduction, increased from 17% during the 2017 Tax Cut and Jobs Act negotiations and made permanent in last year's One Big Beautiful Bill Act, will cost the budget $820bn over a 10-year period, almost as much as was cut from Medicaid.
quote: made permanent in the ”big beautiful bill” last year, will cost the budget $820bn over a 10-year period, almost as much as was cut from the Medicaid budget.
confidence_justification: Legislative facts are firm, but the 10-year cost is a projection presented in an opinion column without an inline source citation.
